labels: P1 Design. Arms N in {16, 128, 1024, 8192} distinct generated practice maps; replicates r in {1, 2, 3, 4}; k = log8(N / 16), the exact integers 0, 1, 2, 3. Each run's final EMA-0.9999 policy played (deterministic) ONE merged test pool whose manifest gives every map's set: "id" (500 maps of the practice construction), "tempo" (250 maps at 1.3x tempo) and "pattern" (250 burst drills); and, separately, its train probe (its first min(N, 256) practice maps). Map records = detail.deterministic.maps of an eval JSON, one per map, in pool order.

P2 Outcome of a set of map records: F = sum of (breaks + tail_miss), O = sum of max_combo_possible, Y = ln(F / O) (lower is better); zero-failure rule: F == 0 -> Y = ln(0.5 / O); O == 0 -> Y null. fc_rate = mean of the per-map "fc", mean_acc = mean of the per-map "acc" (both unweighted over maps), n_maps = number of map records. Per run: Y_id, Y_tempo and Y_pattern (test eval, maps grouped by the manifest's set), Y_probe (every map of the probe eval) and the memorization gap G = Y_id - Y_probe.

P3 Complete-set rule. A replicate counts only if all four of its arms have a run record with complete == true (the JSON boolean). Only complete replicates enter the primary, the secondaries and the per-arm descriptives; every other run is listed in excluded_runs with its reason. With fewer than 3 complete replicates (brief section 12 F3) the primary and every secondary are "Not tested: insufficient replicate sets" (no estimate, interval or p-value); the descriptive results are still computed and reported.

P4 Primary (H1: b < 0). OLS Y_id = alpha_r + b k + e over the n = 4R runs of the R complete replicates, one intercept per replicate (replicate fixed effects, no common intercept). Classical OLS standard error se = s / sqrt(Sxx) with s^2 = RSS / df, df = n - R - 1 and Sxx = the sum of squared within-replicate deviations of k (5 per complete replicate); t = b / se; one-sided p = P(T_df <= t); 95% CI b +- t(0.975, df) se; 90% CI b +- t(0.95, df) se; residual SD = s; intercepts alpha_r. If se == 0: p = 0 when b < 0, else 1 (t is then not finite: null).

P5 R5 category, with delta = 0.15 (ln units per 8x step of N), p_adj = the primary's one-sided p (the primary family has one test) and the 90% CI [lo, hi]: inside = lo > -delta and hi < +delta; beyond = lo > +delta or hi < -delta (all strict). p < 0.05 and beyond: "Exceeds the margin"; p < 0.05 and inside: "Detectable but within the margin"; p < 0.05 and neither: "Detectable difference, magnitude uncertain"; p >= 0.05 and inside: "Equivalent within the margin"; p >= 0.05 and not inside: "Inconclusive". practically_meaningful = (category == "Exceeds the margin"); no other category is given that label in any output.

P6 Secondary family: 7 tests, each one-sided in the predicted direction (estimate < 0), Holm over m = 7 at alpha 0.05. S1-S4 are paired over the complete replicates: d_r = Y_id(8192) - Y_id(16) (S1), Y_id(128) - Y_id(16) (S2), Y_id(1024) - Y_id(128) (S3), Y_id(8192) - Y_id(1024) (S4); estimate = mean d, se = sd / sqrt(n) (sd with ddof 1), df = n - 1, t = mean / se, p = P(T_df <= t), 95% CI mean +- t(0.975, df) se (se == 0 as in P4). S5-S7 are the P4 model's slope on G (S5), Y_tempo (S6) and Y_pattern (S7). Holm: p sorted ascending, p_holm_(i) = max over j <= i of min(1, (m - j + 1) p_(j)); reject when p_holm < 0.05.

P7 Descriptive (no tests). by_arm: per arm over the complete replicates, the mean, the 95% t-interval (df = n - 1; null when n < 2), n and the per-replicate values (values_by_replicate) of Y_id, Y_probe, G, Y_tempo, Y_pattern, fc_rate_id and mean_acc_id. by_band / by_variant: per arm, the id set pooled over the complete replicates by the manifest's band (0, 1, 2) and variant (slider, spinner, streamjump, plain): F, O and Y (P2 on the pooled counts). references: keyed by the name of each reference policy in the batch summary, {id, tempo, pattern (the P2 values of each set), kind, note}. learning_curves: keyed by run name, every run record (complete or not), {N, replicate, monitor, probe, note}: monitor = the eval.jsonl rows named "pd_monitor_ema", probe = the rows named "pd_probe_ema", each row -> [decisions, Y, mean_acc, fc_rate] (settings.curve_columns) from the row's summary.deterministic (failures and objects with the P2 rules); a missing file is skipped with a note.

P8 Integrity; a failure refuses (SystemExit) before anything is written: the batch summary's schema is "pd_batch_summary_v1"; the test manifest's sha256 equals its record; every eval file's sha256 equals its record; every test eval's per-map "map" keys equal the test manifest's key list exactly (same maps, same order: every policy played the identical merged pool), references included; every probe eval's keys equal its probe manifest's keys; no duplicate (N, replicate).

P9 Power (preregistered; power_table(), --power-table): for R in (3, 4) complete replicates and residual SD sigma in (0.05, 0.10, 0.15, 0.20, 0.30, 0.40): df = 4R - R - 1, Sxx = 5R, se = sigma / sqrt(Sxx), 95% CI half-width t(0.975, df) se, 90% CI half-width t(0.95, df) se, approximate minimum detectable slope (one-sided alpha 0.05, 80% power) (t(0.95, df) + t(0.80, df)) se.

P10 Wording. wording.primary_sentence states the estimate, its 95% CI, the one-sided p and the R5 category; only the category "Exceeds the margin" is worded as practically_meaningful. No output contains a word from FORBIDDEN (checked before anything is written).

C1 A run record with complete == true must name a test_eval and a probe_eval (with sha256 records) and a probe_manifest, else refuse: a batch fault, not a design exclusion. An incomplete run's evals are read and checked when present; its per-run values are reported in "runs" and never pooled; absent evals -> null sets.

C2 Refused as malformed: N outside the four arms, a replicate outside 1-4, a run without a name, duplicate run names, duplicate reference names; a test-manifest map whose set is not id / tempo / pattern, a set with no map, duplicate manifest keys; a map record without map, fc, max_combo_possible, breaks, tail_miss or acc, or with a non-numeric count. sha256 records compare case-insensitively.

C3 A secondary test that is not estimable (a null per-run value) enters Holm as p = 1 (m stays 7); it reports status "Not estimable: ..." and null values. A test that runs has status "Tested". Not tested -> every value null, n null. The primary reports n (runs in complete replicate sets) and n_replicates in every status.
C4 by_band / by_variant cells also give n_maps (that cell's test maps, per run) and n_runs (complete replicates pooled); with no complete replicate F, O and Y are null.

C5 Learning-curve rows keep file order (duplicates kept); a row without failures or objects gets Y null; an unparsable line is skipped and counted in the note; eval_jsonl null or a missing file -> empty curves and a note.
C6 "version" is an object: the version label, this script's path and sha256, and the python, numpy and scipy versions.
C7 Recorded paths are relative to --root (posix) when the file lies under it, else absolute.
C8 A reference whose test_eval is null gets id, tempo and pattern null and a note.

C9 A reference's test_eval may instead be the <out>_maps.json of scripts/sim_autopilot_objects.py (the brief's tool for the autopilot): the same per-map records as a top-level "maps" list, with the same sha256 and key checks. Run evals must be scripts/sim_eval_pool.py output (detail.deterministic.maps).

failures F, failures on spinner-drill maps, spinners completed of 799): `pd_n16_r1` 6,036 / 176 / 773;
  `pd_n16_r2` 4,193 / 343 / 324; `pd_n16_r3` 5,447 / 499 / 167; `pd_n256_r1` 764 / 231 / 411; `pd_n256_r2` 1,206 / 390

  Spinner-drill maps hold 349 of `pd_n4096_r1`'s 794-failure advantage over r2 and 358 of 834 over r3 (lens 2's figures,

value.interpretation: Completed spinners fell from 16 to 256 maps and rose from 256 to 4096 maps in every replicate. Replicate 1 at 4096 maps alone completed all 799 spinners. Spinner-drill maps account for nearly half of its failure advantage over the other 4096-map runs, and it still leads on the remaining maps. Improvement at 4096 maps is mostly, not only, through replicate 1.

value.classification: descriptive exposure limitation; not an additional treatment or confirmatory test
value.interpretation: At the fixed budget, each map received thousands of clips with 16 maps, hundreds with 256 maps and about twenty with 4096 maps. Total notes played per run differed by several percent. The design does not separate diversity from reduced repetition per map.
